title: Dagmar gives you one more chance

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: You got some nerve showing your face here, slimefish. I told you to convince that asshole critic, not piss him off!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got some nerve showing your face here, slimefish. I told you to convince that asshole critic, not piss him off!

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Bullshit. Did you see what he said about me? "The floors are as clean as the owner's conscience, and the dishes have one flavor: no."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bullshit. Did you see what he said about me? "The floors are as clean as the owner's conscience, and the dishes have one flavor: no."

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Look at my stats! Look at them! A 21% decline overnight! Why is this happening to lovely me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look at my stats! Look at them! A 21% decline overnight! Why is this happening to lovely me?

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: I don't want to hear it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want to hear it!

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: I've got an ace up my sleeve. Didn't want to use it but since you fucked up my dealings I'm gonna have to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've got an ace up my sleeve. Didn't want to use it but since you fucked up my dealings I'm gonna have to.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: A hygiene inspector's remote access chip. I had that cretin Cecil Grimes mugged a few months ago. Cost me a bomb.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A hygiene inspector's remote access chip. I had that cretin Cecil Grimes mugged a few months ago. Cost me a bomb.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: It's a one-time login. I've been saving it for an emergency. And this is a fucking emergency.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a one-time login. I've been saving it for an emergency. And this is a fucking emergency.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Change my hygiene rating to excellent. and drop everyone else's score while you're at it. That should bring the customers crawling back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Change my hygiene rating to excellent. and drop everyone else's score while you're at it. That should bring the customers crawling back.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Because it's illegal, jackass. And because I have you to do it for me. Because you want to succeed. Don't you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because it's illegal, jackass. And because I have you to do it for me. Because you want to succeed. Don't you?

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Good. Do this and we'll be partners, you and I. All the way to the top.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good. Do this and we'll be partners, you and I. All the way to the top.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: How dare you, after all I've done? Get out of my sight. If I ever see you again, I'll spoon out your eyes and fry them with bacon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How dare you, after all I've done? Get out of my sight. If I ever see you again, I'll spoon out your eyes and fry them with bacon.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: I want my business back in the black! Now! And since it was YOUR fault, you're going to help me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want my business back in the black! Now! And since it was YOUR fault, you're going to help me.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: It'll give you access to the hygiene system via a CorpSec terminal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It'll give you access to the hygiene system via a CorpSec terminal.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Use it to access a CorpSec terminal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Use it to access a CorpSec terminal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hey, I tried my best.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I tried my best.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What an asshole.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What an asshole.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe he has a point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe he has a point.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can think of a few reasons...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can think of a few reasons...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can think of a few reasons...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can think of a few reasons...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want this time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want this time?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want this time?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want this time?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why haven't you used it already?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why haven't you used it already?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why haven't you used it already?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why haven't you used it already?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sick.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sick.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you want me to...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you want me to...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why can't you do it yourself?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why can't you do it yourself?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why can't you do it yourself?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why can't you do it yourself?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds easy enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds easy enough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not if success looks like you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not if success looks like you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not if success looks like you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not if success looks like you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just inexplicable!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just inexplicable!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you think it's worth it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you think it's worth it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you think it's worth it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you think it's worth it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think it's worth it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think it's worth it!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think it's worth it!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think it's worth it!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't like where this is going!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't like where this is going!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't like where this is going!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't like where this is going!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're the devil, Dagmar!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're the devil, Dagmar!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Here it comes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here it comes.

nodes.text: Dagmar gives you one more chance
Dagmar gives you one more chance
